caption: Page 299 of Le Tour du Monde, vol. 12 (1865), containing Griffon du Bellay's description of iboga as an aphrodisiac and stimulant.
alt: Printed French page headed "LE GABON" and numbered 299, with a paragraph naming "l'iboga (taberna-ventricosa, famille des apocynées)" as the most esteemed local aphrodisiac.
credit: Wikimedia Commons (scan of Le Tour du Monde, vol. 12, 1865, Hachette)
note: The hosted transcript came from French Wikisource, which has no images; the underlying page scan is hosted on Wikimedia Commons as File:Le Tour du monde - 12.djvu (page 299), matching the excerpt's mention of l'ibôga almost verbatim.
